item.title: [6.8] India 10-year bond yield reverses half of last week's drop on elevated inflation
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Indian government bonds experienced significant selling pressure ahead of a major auction for the benchmark paper. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise interest rates again in early December due to persistent inflationary pressures.
